messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#PD-8421 severity: P1 - auth.token.verify.failures (prod)

pagerduty: Incident PD-8421 created and routed to on-call. Escalation policy: infra-sre -> eng-sre-lead.

Dylan K.: acked on PagerDuty, picking up initial triage. seeing spike in jwt verify failures across all regions.

Maya R.: noticed a customer alert stream too — several customers reporting 401s from API gateway. not all endpoints, mostly token-auth paths.

Dylan K.: rolling logs: getting a lot of `jwt: kid not found` and `jwks: no matching key for kid` from token-verify svc. pattern started ~3845001100 (a bit before the PD alert).

Kevin T.: @Dylan can you paste a sample of the error and the jwks response from cache node? want to check for stale keysets.

Dylan K.: paste logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:08:41Z token-verify[pid:2345] ERROR jwt: verification failed user=svc-connector err="kid not found"
2026-03-15T10:08:42Z token-verify[pid:2345] DEBUG found kty=RSA, alg=RS256 but kid not matched
```
jwks response from cache node (curl to local cache):
```
{ "keys": [ { "kty": "RSA", "kid": "old-key-2026-03-15", "alg": "RS256" } ] }
```
gateway headers show `kid: rotated-key-2026-03-15` in incoming tokens.

Ashley P.: so tokens are signed with new kid but our cache/verify nodes still have old key only. sounds like JWKS propagation lag after rotation. any recent deploys to auth?

Maya R.: we rotated signing keys ~10 minutes before spike as part of scheduled rotation. rotation pipeline reported success but looks like not all caches invalidated.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigation options:
- force JWKS cache reload on verification fleet
- temporarily accept tokens signed by previous key id (legacy-key) if possible (risk: security)
- rollback rotation (reintroduce old signing key as source of truth)

Dylan K.: executing cache reload across token-verify nodes now: `for host in $(cat token-verify-hosts); do ssh $host sudo /opt/redwood/bin/jwks-reload || echo reload-failed-$host; done`

pagerduty: PD-8421 status: acknowledged by Dylan K. -> assigned to eng-sre.

Kevin T.: I'm elevating to P1 page to SRE lead. joining bridge. starting coordination: @Maya please confirm which key IDs were deployed and the rotation workflow steps.

Maya R.: rotation details: new key `rotated-key-2026-03-15` published to JWKS endpoint (auth.internal.jwks/v1). rotation job pushed to edge-cdn, then cache invalidation message emitted to pubsub. pubsub acked by 3/3 subscribers, but verification fleet logs show no pubsub messages processed on some AZs.

Dylan K.: cache-reload script returned reload-failed for 2 hosts: verify-az2-03 and verify-az3-01. ssh shows `connection refused` for verify-az3-01 — maybe node is overloaded.

Kevin T.: ok, plan: 1) escalate to infra to reprovision/respawn unresponsive nodes; 2) add temporary fallback in token-verify logic to consult remote JWKS endpoint when cache miss occurs (fast patch); 3) short TTL on JWKS cache once healthy to avoid recurrence. Who can handle step 2 quickly?

Ashley P.: I can open a hotfix PR to token-verify to call auth.internal.jwks/v1 on cache miss and retry. will target canary and run for 15 minutes.

Maya R.: customer impact: dashboards show ~12% of auth requests returning 401s in EU and US-west. small subset of customers (~5 orgs) have degraded experience (login failures and API auth). CS alerted and escalating.

oncall-sre: please post status update in #customer-impact with ETA. we should also create a short status page note (opsinc) if more than 10% or high-value customers affected.

Dylan K.: CS update posted. pinged the 5 customers via CS with workaround (reissue tokens) and told them we're working on infra fix.

Kevin T.: infra team confirmed two problem nodes were OOMing due to a memory leak in telemetry agent — they restarted the instances and verified connectivity. verify-az2-03 back online, verify-az3-01 reprovisioned.

Ashley P.: hotfix PR merged to canary (sha abc123). canary shows JWKS fallback succeeds; token-verify can now fetch remote JWKS on cache miss and validate rotated-key. Rolling to 10% now.

Maya R.: monitoring after canary: error rate dropped from 12% -> 2% in canary hosts. starting rollout to 50% in US, 50% EU in 10m.

pagerduty: PD-8421: escalation to eng-sre-lead acknowledged by Kevin T.

Dylan K.: rolling full rollout now. running sweep to explicitly invalidate caches after rollout: `curl -XPOST https://auth.internal/admin/keys/invalidate-cache -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"`

Maya R.: post-rollout metrics at +25m: auth failures down to 0.5% globally. affected customers re-tested, most report success.

Kevin T.: root cause summary (prelim): signing-key rotation completed but JWKS propagation to verification fleet lagged due to a telemetry agent OOM which prevented pubsub invalidation processing on two AZs. fallback not implemented in token-verify, so cache misses surfaced as `kid not found`.

Kevin T.: action items:
- infra: fix telemetry agent memory leak and add OOM alerts (owner: infra, ETA 48h)
- dev: implement JWKS fetch-on-miss fallback and reduce cache TTL; add unit+integration tests for rotation scenarios (owner: auth team, ETA 24h for tests, 72h for rollout)
- ops: add runbook steps for forced JWKS cache reloads and improve rotation runbooks to wait for verification fleet confirmation (owner: eng-sre, ETA 24h)

oncall-sre: handing off to Kevin T. for post-incident follow-up. Dylan, great quick triage. Marking incident as resolved for immediate customer impact.

Dylan K.: handing off logs and commands to Kevin in #incident-postmortem. I'll stay available for follow-up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-8421 status: resolved (severity P1) at 3845004728.

Kevin T.: creating postmortem doc and will link internal RCA to the incident ticket PD-8421.

Ashley P.: adding the hotfix PR link and rollback notes to the incident doc.

Maya R.: closing Slack thread, will update stakeholding teams via email with timeline.
